subject: general
question: Metal oxides are generally ________ in nature.
solution:
The Correct answer is **Alkaline.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points**

__
 
• **Metal oxides have a simple chemical structure.**
 
• An **oxygen atom** is connected to another **atom** in a chemical known as **an oxide.**
 
• These compounds can be created by partnering oxygen atoms with metals, which donate their electrons in their valence shells in the process.
 
• Since they react with weak acids to produce **salt and water, metal oxides are basic in nature.**
 
• Ionic metal oxides typically react with substances that produce water and contain hydroxide ions. A basic solution is created as a result of the reaction with water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• They are basic because** salt and water** are created when **metal oxides and acids react. **They are **basic** because they **neutralise the acids.**
 
• **Acidic oxides** can be produced by **metalloids or nonmetals**. With water, they react, producing an** acidic solution.**
 
• The **oxides known as amphoteric oxides** exhibit **both acidic and basic** behaviour. **Amphoteric oxides **are neutralizers of** both acids and bases** with characteristics of **both acidic and basic oxides.**
